newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks end down on blue chip selling.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks end down on blue chip selling.

text.p: Pakistani stocks sank at Wednesday's close on blue chip selling by foreign investors, dealers said.
The Karachi 100-share index ended 27.01 points, or 1.72 percent, down at 1542.96 amid 250 losers and 45 gainers.
Unabated selling of blue chips hammered the index, dealer Kausar Abbas said.

PTCL dropped 1.20 rupees to 28.25, Hub Power 0.80 to 37.20, ICI Pakistan 1.20 to 21.95, Dewan Salman 1.40 to 37.90, Pakistan State Oil 6.00 to 292, Shell Pakistan 3.00 to 209 and Lever Brothers 5.00 to 700. -- Ibrahim Khan 9221-5685192
